test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, L, M, Y and X are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people sit between B and L when counted from the right of L. X sits to the immediate left of Y. A sits to the immediate right of M. Y is an immediate neighbour of L.

Who sits fourth to the right of C?
solution:
Given, A, B, C, L, M, Y and X are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

Only two people sit between B and L when counted from the right of L.

Y is an immediate neighbour of L.

X sits to the immediate left of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab9d3599002f3cdfca7ba216adda75a0802c3d11f6ea08fc6434f3d6e342764d.png] 

A sits to the immediate right of M.

And C sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ecb3d4aefa5e1ab0b9bb40ea20b3dc4ee65dd88c608167779495813dafddc67.png] 

From diagram, M sits fourth to the right of C.

Hence the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
